summary.text: Sean Dougherty is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 172 since December 1, 2024 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a trial attorney by profession.

paragraphs.text: Sean Dougherty graduated from LaSalle College High School in 2012, earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Chestnut Hill College in 2016, and received a law degree from Temple University in 2019.
His career experience includes working as a trial attorney.
He succeeded Democrat Kevin Boyle in the seat.
